messages.content: 案件編號XY1234在Los Angeles County Court和案件編號GH5678在Orange County Court的狀態和預定審判日期是什麼？

function.name: court_info_get_case_status
function.description: Retrieves the status and trial dates for court cases from specified county courts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

court.description: The county court where the case is filed.

details.description: Specific details required about the court case. Defaults to 'status'.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "案件編號XY1234在Los Angeles County Court和案件編號GH5678在Orange County Court的狀態和預定審判日期是什麼？" They want the status and scheduled trial date for two cases: XY1234 in Los Angeles County Court, GH5678 in Orange County Court.

We need to call the function twice: one for each case. The function signature: court_info_get_case_status takes case_number, court, details optional default 'status'. We need both status and trial_date. So we can call with details='status' and details='trial_date', or maybe we can request both? The function only accepts one detail at a time. So we need to call twice per case: once for status, once for trial_date. That would be 4 calls total. But maybe we can combine? The function signature says details?: "status" | "trial_date". So we can't get both in one call. So we need separate calls.

Thus we will call:

1. court_info_get_case_status({"case_number":"XY1234","court":"Los Angeles County Court","details":"status"})
2. court_info_get_case_status({"case_number":"XY1234","court":"Los Angeles County Court","details":"trial_date"})
3. court_info_get_case_status({"case_number":"GH5678","court":"Orange County Court","details":"status"})
4. court_info_get_case_status({"case_number":"GH5678","court":"Orange County Court","details":"trial_date"})

We should output the results after calling. We'll do them sequentially.
